texts.zh: 似乎有第三方恶意入侵了驻在[Root.Capital.GetName]的[envoy_source.GetAdj]特使，[event_envoy.GetName]所使用的翻译软件，结果不同于平日宽宏的陈词滥调，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]开始恶毒地羞辱，把众人骂了个遍。[event_envoy.GetHerHis]设备的故障已被及时查明，但在此之前[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]已经被说成是“卑鄙的[ruler_species.GetNameInsult]”——他们肯定会对这种严重羞辱加以回应。
texts.en: It appears that a mischievous third party was able to hack into the translation software of the [envoy_source.GetAdj] envoy to [Root.Capital.GetName], [event_envoy.GetName], so that instead of uttering magnanimous platitudes, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] began spewing vicious insults that left none unscathed. The malfunction in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] equipment was duly uncovered, but not before [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] was declared to be a "vile [ruler_species.GetNameInsult]" - a grave insult which surely calls for a response.

texts.zh:
似乎有第三方恶意入侵了我们派往[From.GetName]的特使[event_envoy.GetName]所使用的翻译软件，结果[event_envoy.GetHerHis]原本宽宏的外交辞令变成了恶毒的羞辱，把众人骂了个遍——尤其是他们的[From.GetRulerTitle]，被说成是“卑鄙的[ruler_species.GetNameInsult]”。

尽管故障被迅速查明，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不觉得这个事故好笑，并且正式控诉了我国特使的不当行为。
texts.en:
It appears that a mischievous third party was able to hack into the translation software of our envoy to the [From.GetName], [event_envoy.GetName], so that [event_envoy.GetHerHis] magnanimous platitudes instead became vicious insults that left none unscathed - not least their [From.GetRulerTitle], who was declared to be a "vile [ruler_species.GetNameInsult]".

Although the malfunction was swiftly uncovered, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were not amused at the incident and have lodged an official complaint at the inappropriate behavior of our envoy.

It appears that a mischievous third party was able to hack into the translation software of our envoy to the [From.GetName], [event_envoy.GetName], so that [event_envoy.GetHerHis] magnanimous platitudes instead became vicious insults that left none unscathed - not least their [From.GetRulerTitle], who was declared to be a "vile [ruler_species.GetNameInsult]".

# 无礼的[envoy_source.GetAdj]特使 / Insulting [envoy_source.GetAdj] Envoy

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/envoy_events.txt:15-285`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

Galactic Community 特使的随机事件：五年脉冲（action.2211）的负面列表 on_five_year_random_pulse_country_negative_list，权重见分支栏（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592）；on_action 会先检查事件触发条件、不满足的从列表中剔除，所以只要有一个能触发就必有一个触发。通常共用5400天的 recent_envoy_event 冷却。 本事件：五年脉冲负面列表（权重10/180；也兼容“引爆外交事故”行动，见注）：隐藏事件 envoy_events.1001 立即发出 envoy_events.1。

A random Galactic Community envoy event: the negative list of the five-year pulse (action.2211), on_five_year_random_pulse_country_negative_list, weights in the branches (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592); on_actions check each event's trigger first and drop the failing ones, so as long as any can fire one always does. Most share a 5400-day recent_envoy_event cooldown. This event: The negative five-year list (weight 10 of 180; also safe for the "Stage a Diplomatic Incident" operation, see notes): hidden envoy_events.1001 immediately fires envoy_events.1.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

envoy_events.1：第三方入侵了某国特使的翻译软件，让特使口出秽言（选项“真无礼”/“好笑”）；随后 envoy_events.2 告知对方也有同样的事发生在本国特使身上。

envoy_events.1: a mischievous third party hacked the translation software of a foreign envoy to say insulting things (options "How rude." / "Well, that was funny!"); envoy_events.2 then tells that the same happened to our envoy.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无分支。

No branches.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

核对了脚本触发和选项；与同一列表中的其他事件互相独立。

Trigger and options were checked against the script; independent of the other events in the same list.
